'''Ganath''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] hidden within the unchartered depths of the [[Oktos Nebula/Legends|Oktos Nebula]], a [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] of intensely [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] interstellar [[Gas/Legends|gas]] near [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].

==History==
Ganath was [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ganathan]]s. The planet was inside the uncharted [[Oktos Nebula/Legends|Oktos Nebula]], and despite being close to important worlds like [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], it remained isolated from the wider [[galactic community]], attaining a legendary status. The Ganathans reached their industrial and space age by using steam-powered technology.<ref name="TEA" /> Their primitive steam spaceships could move around the limited [[Ganathan Space]].

The severely injured [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Empatojayos Brand]] hid there and survived the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. He was made [[King/Legends|king]] of the Ganathans and ruled by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] creed of justice until discovered by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] fleeing from [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the crises surrounding the resurrected [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] on [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. He joined her, leaving Ganath behind.

At a later point, the Ganathan cruiser ''[[Robida Colossus]]'' joined the Rebel fleet, possibly indicating Ganath joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

Allegiances aside, Ganath was lucky to avoid attracting the attention of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TEA" />
